messages.author: a151e0a0591b25be
messages.subject: error with geom_bar
parts:
Hi All,

I just started to explore ggplot2 which seems like an awesome package.
However, I faced an error below

"stat_bin: binwidth defaulted to range/30. Use 'binwidth = x' to
adjust this.
Error in pmin(y, 0) : object 'y' not found"

My code is below:

p<-ggplot(Data,aes(x=DATE,y=PRINCIPAL))
p+geom_bar()


Which puzzles me is that a code below works just fine:

p<-ggplot(Data,aes(x=DATE,y=PRINCIPAL))
p+geom_point()

So I am missing something when trying to create a bar chart..

Br,
Jack

messages.author: affa918ed63b6275
messages.subject: Re: error with geom_bar
parts:
hi, try this:

p<-ggplot(Data,aes(x=DATE,y=PRINCIPAL))
p+geom_bar(stat="identity")
